{"subject":"Modernising the shipment-tracking cluster","body":"Hi Joris,

Lumen Logistics' shipment-tracking service writes 2B events/day to DataStax Enterprise 6.8, and your team appears focused on modernising that cluster and cutting operational toil. With DataStax offerings now moving under IBM, it could also be a good moment to review options.

ScyllaDB provides migration tooling and support for moving live Cassandra/DSE workloads like that one.

Would it be useful if I sent a short overview of how that migration path works?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB
